steps.text: The mug is upright on the far side of the tabletop. I’m using the static camera’s calibrated depth to recover tabletop and mug positions in the robot base frame, so the target is the table’s geometric center rather than the center of the visible image.

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/output/start_egocentric_mirrored_camera.png'))
d=np.load('/app/output/start_depth_egocentric_mirrored_camera.npy')
K=np.array([[989.549,0,432],[0,989.549,240],[0,0,1.]])

y,x=np.indices(d.shape)
z=d
valid=(z>0)&(y>100)&(x<790)
cam=np.stack([(x-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],(y-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],z,np.ones_like(z)],-1)

for name,mask in [('all',valid),('wood',wood)]:

+"""Recorded RoboLab trajectory for white_mug_in_center_of_table.

+

+
+

+last = robot.get_obs(depth=True, video="none")
+
+
+def move(label: str, x: float, y: float, z: float, gripper: float):
+    """Send one measured-orientation TCP waypoint and retain its observation."""
+    global last
+    q = np.asarray(last.meta["proprio"]["now"][11:15], dtype=np.float32)
+    row = np.asarray([[x, y, z, *q, gripper]], dtype=np.float32)

+        last = robot.submit(

+        )
+    except EpisodeOver as exc:
+        print(f"episode ended: {exc}")
+        return None
+    print(
+        label,
+        "plan=", last.meta.get("plan"),
+        "tcp=", np.round(last.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:11], 4),
+        "done=", last.meta.get("done"),
+        "reason=", last.meta.get("reason"),
+    )
+    return last
+
+

+    ("descend around mug body", 0.283, -0.078, 0.035, 0.0),
